name: Multi-Parent Shared Infrastructure Cost Allocation Rollup
description: Cloud infrastructure (e.g. shared Kubernetes cluster) is co-owned by multiple products with fractional split percentages. Costs must cascade down to consumer business units.
prompt:
Cloud infrastructure (e.g. shared Kubernetes cluster) is co-owned by multiple products with fractional split percentages. Costs must cascade down to consumer business units.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: parent_node, child_node, allocation_pct, raw_parent_cost, allocated_cost.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Allocate parent cost to child business units
            SELECT 
                a.parent_node,
                a.child_node,
                a.allocation_pct,
                n.monthly_cost AS raw_parent_cost,
                ROUND(n.monthly_cost * a.allocation_pct, 2) AS allocated_cost
            FROM cost_allocations a
            JOIN cost_nodes n ON a.parent_node = n.node_id
            ORDER BY allocated_cost DESC;
why_it_fails: Failing to multiply split percentages down the DAG results in allocated costs exceeding 100% of actual spend.
